title: Sandboxed autotune advisor and guarded apply for on-prem/private networks
creator: Nina Chen
description: Build a guarded recommendation and dry-run apply flow for batching/caching autotuning that runs safely in Private/VPC/on-prem environments. The feature must produce deterministic cost/latency impact estimates, support offline simulation mode (no control-plane changes), enforce org policies (whitelist/blacklist settings), and surface actionable roll-forward and rollback steps to operators. Must integrate with the existing Private control plane and respect customer-managed KMS and network restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: Autotune engine can produce per-model batching and prefix-cache recommendations for a VPC/deployed cluster without modifying runtime configs in dry-run mode
Simulation output includes estimated token-cost delta, 95th/avg latency impact, and failure modes (e.g., cache eviction risk)
Policy engine blocks any recommendation that violates customer or org policies and emits a clear explainable reason
Guarded ‘apply’ is a two-step operation: a restricted agent (with limited RBAC) can push a staged change that only affects canary traffic; full rollout requires explicit operator approval
Rollback instructions are auto-generated and validated via a dry-run before any staged apply
End-to-end tests exercising on-prem offline mode, policy enforcement, and rollback path are added to CI
implementation_notes: Add a sandbox runner module under runtime/autotune that can replay traces against a simulated KV/batching layer without requiring GPU access
Re-use kernel selection telemetry to approximate latency impact; supplement with small microbenchmarks where possible
Implement a policy adapter that reads customer rules from the Private control plane and maps them to internal constraints (max_batch_size, quantization_allowed, cache_enabled)
Design output schema: recommendation_id, affected_routes, params_before, params_after, estimated_monthly_savings, latency_p50/p95_delta, risk_tags
Persist dry-run artifacts in customer-specific storage with TTL and audit metadata (actor, timestamp, reason) to satisfy compliance requirements
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): sandbox runner + output schema + unit tests (internal cluster)
Phase 2 (private-beta): integrate with two pilot customers' VPCs behind feature flag; run recommendation-only dry-runs for 2 weeks
Phase 3 (guarded-apply): implement RBAC gated staged apply and rollback; manual operator approval required for full rollout
Phase 4 (GA): enable default dry-run reports in Console and allow opt-in for automatic canary applies with policy guard
Monitoring: monitor unit-cost, canary failure rate, and rollback frequency; set alert if rollback > 2 per week per customer
comments: 2026-02-18 - Nina Chen: spike complete. Sandbox runner can replay KV traces but needs deterministic randomness control to make sim repeatable.
2026-02-24 - Marco Diaz (review): prefer we avoid adding any new control-plane RPCs in private customers; use in-cluster artifact exchange instead.
2026-03-01 - Lucas Meyer: added policy adapter prototype. Current gap: mapping customer-written rules to internal constraint enums.
2026-03-04 - Security review request submitted. Key items: verifying dry-run artifacts never leak model prompts or customer PII and that KMS keys are never exported.

2026-03-08 - QA: ran simulation against sample on-prem traces; found a regression where cache-enabled recommendation increases 95th latency for long-sequence workloads — marking as risk_tag 'long_sequence_latency'

2026-03-10 - PM review (Aisha Patel): OK to proceed to private-beta once policy adapter can block quantization for customers with strict model fidelity requirements. Also asked for clear UX copy for rollback explanation.
